q.g: In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it. Afterwards a Zibbo lighter has to be stashed in the same location.

sh.c: 3 story dorms and room 303 marked on map
